questions.q: Elective or appointive public officials or employees cannot accept any present, compensation, office or title of any kind from any foreign government without the consent of:

Which of the following rights ensure the well-being of the individual and foster preservation, enrichment and dynamic evolution of national culture based on the principle of unity in diversity in a climate of free artistic and intellectual expression?
Right that guarantees similar treatment to all persons similarly situated and precludes arbitrary or unjust discrimination to secure and safeguard such right is called the _________.
options: right to equal protection of the law
right to due process of law
right to profess one's faith or religion
questions.answer: right to equal protection of the law

questions.q: The right to privacy of a person is defined as one's right to __________.
options: build a home wherever one chooses
be a member of any group

questions.q: A voter is disqualified from exercising the right to suffrage if said voter __________.
options: turned 20 years old just before the election
has been a resident of the Philippines for less than six months
questions.answer: has been a resident of the Philippines for less than six months

questions.q: Who may be appointed as member of the Cabinet without needing confirmation from the Commission on Appointments?

The right of private individuals to secure for themselves the enjoyment of their means of happiness such as the right to a name, the right to form a family, and the right to security of personal papers and effects are called ___________.
At least how many years after the Constitution has been ratified may the people propose amendments through initiative?
Which of the following sectors is NOT represented in the House of Representatives through the party-list system?

Which of the following government agencies exercises original and exclusive jurisdiction over all contests relating to the election returns and the qualifications of the President and the Vice President?
Who among the following is responsible for determining the existence of probable cause for the issuance of a warrant of arrest or search warrant?
Which of the following statements BEST describes the relationship between global warming and ozone depletion?
options: Global warming contributes to ozone depletion.
Global warming and ozone depletion have nothing to do with each other
Excessive build-up of carbon dioxide causes both global warming and ozone depletion
Ozone depletion contributes to global warming
Ozone depletion and global warming are synonyms
questions.answer: Excessive build-up of carbon dioxide causes both global warming and ozone depletion

questions.q: Monoculture cropping or planting a single crop in a large area is not advisable because it:

options: mobile nature of fish and water
increasing demand for fish, which is rich in protein

questions.q: Every government agency is required to develop, update regularly, and make available to the transacting public __________.

Within the provided periods of time, public officials and employees are required to file their statement of assets and liabilities and financial disclosure in the following instances EXCEPT __________.
options: expiration of the term of office
